checks.title: Host firewall is enabled
checks.evidence: ufw is installed but disabled (ENABLED=no in /etc/ufw/ufw.conf)
checks.recommendation: Enable a default-deny host firewall (e.g. `ufw default deny incoming && ufw enable`, or nftables with an input chain policy of drop) and allow only required services.

checks.title: No duplicate UID 0 (root-equivalent) accounts
checks.evidence: Accounts with UID 0 besides root: svc-backup
checks.recommendation: Only 'root' may have UID 0. Investigate and remove/renumber other UID 0 accounts immediately.

checks.title: No accounts with empty passwords
checks.recommendation: Lock or set a strong password on every account with an empty password field (`passwd -l <user>`).

checks.title: System accounts have no interactive shell
checks.evidence: System accounts with a login shell: postgres. Interactive accounts: alice, bob, root, svc-backup
checks.recommendation: Set the shell of service/system accounts to /usr/sbin/nologin (`usermod -s /usr/sbin/nologin <user>`).

checks.title: Active user sessions inventory
checks.evidence: Session inventory is only available on a live host
checks.recommendation: Review active sessions regularly and terminate unexpected ones.

checks.title: No high-risk services listening on all interfaces
checks.evidence: Exposed on all interfaces: tcp/3306 MySQL
checks.recommendation: Bind databases and admin services to localhost or a management interface, disable cleartext protocols (Telnet/FTP/rsh) and restrict access with the host firewall.

checks.title: Listening ports inventory
checks.recommendation: Verify every listening port is expected and documented; disable unused services.

checks.title: Password aging policy is enforced
checks.recommendation: In /etc/login.defs set PASS_MAX_DAYS 365 (or less), PASS_MIN_DAYS 1 and PASS_WARN_AGE 7.

checks.title: Strong password hashing algorithm
checks.recommendation: Set ENCRYPT_METHOD to YESCRYPT or SHA512 in /etc/login.defs and force affected users to change passwords.

checks.title: Password complexity is enforced (pam_pwquality)
checks.evidence: No pam_pwquality/pam_cracklib module in the PAM password stack
checks.recommendation: Install libpam-pwquality, reference pam_pwquality.so in the PAM password stack and set minlen = 14 in /etc/security/pwquality.conf.

checks.title: sudo always requires authentication (no NOPASSWD)
checks.evidence: Passwordless sudo rules: /etc/sudoers.d/deploy: bob ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL
checks.recommendation: Remove NOPASSWD and !authenticate from sudoers rules (use `visudo`); grant passwordless sudo only to narrowly scoped automation commands.

checks.title: sudo uses a pseudo-terminal and logs to a file
checks.recommendation: Add `Defaults use_pty` and `Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo.log"` to /etc/sudoers.d/hardening.

checks.title: SSH root login is disabled
checks.recommendation: Set `PermitRootLogin no` in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and administer via named accounts + sudo.

checks.title: SSH password authentication is disabled
checks.recommendation: Deploy SSH keys, then set `PasswordAuthentication no` and `KbdInteractiveAuthentication no`.

checks.title: SSH empty passwords are prohibited
checks.recommendation: Set `PermitEmptyPasswords no`.

checks.title: SSH MaxAuthTries is 4 or less
checks.recommendation: Set `MaxAuthTries 4` to slow down online guessing.

checks.title: SSH X11 forwarding is disabled
checks.recommendation: Set `X11Forwarding no` unless strictly required.

checks.title: SSH uses strong cryptographic algorithms only
checks.recommendation: Remove CBC/arcfour/3DES ciphers, MD5/SHA1-96 MACs and SHA-1 key exchanges from Ciphers, MACs and KexAlgorithms (or rely on modern OpenSSH defaults).

checks.title: SSH idle session timeout is configured
checks.recommendation: Set `ClientAliveInterval 300` and `ClientAliveCountMax 3` (idle sessions closed after ~15 min).

checks.title: SSH LoginGraceTime is 60 seconds or less
checks.recommendation: Set `LoginGraceTime 60` to limit unauthenticated connection slots (also mitigates some DoS/race attacks).

checks.title: Critical system files have restrictive permissions
checks.evidence: /etc/shadow mode 0o644 must not be accessible by others
checks.recommendation: Restore permissions: `chmod 644 /etc/passwd /etc/group; chmod 640 /etc/shadow /etc/gshadow; chmod 440 /etc/sudoers; chmod 600 /etc/ssh/sshd_config`.

checks.title: Address space layout randomisation (ASLR) is fully enabled
checks.recommendation: Set `kernel.randomize_va_space = 2` in /etc/sysctl.d/60-hardening.conf and run `sysctl --system`.

checks.title: IPv4 forwarding is disabled (non-router hosts)
checks.recommendation: Set `net.ipv4.ip_forward = 0` unless the host is a router or container host (Docker requires it).

checks.title: Automatic security updates are configured
checks.evidence: No automatic security update mechanism detected
checks.recommendation: Debian/Ubuntu: `apt install unattended-upgrades && dpkg-reconfigure -plow unattended-upgrades`. RHEL family: enable dnf-automatic with apply_updates = yes. On rolling distributions (Kali/Parrot) schedule regular `apt full-upgrade` instead.

checks.title: System auditing (auditd) is installed
checks.recommendation: Install and enable auditd (`apt install auditd && systemctl enable --now auditd`) with rules for identity, sudoers and authentication events.
